name: Two MA one RSI
summary: This EA uses a dual moving average crossover system filtered by RSI to generate trend-following trade signals. It enters long when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and RSI confirms momentum, and enters short on the reverse condition. The strategy is a classic trend-following approach with an RSI momentum filter to reduce false signals.
summary_zh: 该EA使用双均线交叉系统并配合RSI过滤器来生成趋势跟踪交易信号。当快速均线上穿慢速均线且RSI确认动量时做多，反之时做空。这是一个经典的趋势跟踪策略，通过RSI动量过滤减少假信号。
strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是双均线交叉趋势跟踪，结合RSI动量指标作为入场过滤器。入场条件为：快速均线上穿慢速均线且RSI高于阈值时做多，快速均线下穿慢速均线且RSI低于阈值时做空。出场条件依赖于均线反向交叉信号或固定止损止盈。仓位管理方面，该EA使用固定手数或基于资金的仓位计算方式。资金管理上依赖用户设定的止损止盈参数控制单笔风险，但缺乏整体资金管理和最大回撤控制机制。RSI过滤器的加入有效减少了震荡行情中的虚假交叉信号，提高了入场质量。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is a dual moving average crossover trend-following system combined with an RSI momentum filter for entry validation. Entry conditions are: go long when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and RSI is above its threshold, and go short on the reverse crossover with RSI below its threshold. Exit conditions rely on the opposite MA crossover signal or fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or an equity-based calculation method. Money management depends on user-configured stop-loss and take-profit parameters to control per-trade risk, but lacks overall portfolio-level money management and maximum drawdown controls. The RSI filter effectively reduces false crossover signals during ranging markets, improving entry quality.
pros: 双均线交叉结合RSI过滤，逻辑清晰易懂，降低了震荡市的假信号
策略参数可调性强，用户可根据不同品种和时间周期优化
趋势跟踪策略在明显趋势行情中表现良好，能捕捉较大波段利润
RSI动量确认机制有效过滤了弱势交叉信号，提高了胜率
pros_en: Dual MA crossover with RSI filter provides clear and understandable logic, reducing false signals in ranging markets
Highly adjustable parameters allow users to optimize for different instruments and timeframes
Trend-following strategy performs well in clear trending markets, capturing significant swing profits
RSI momentum confirmation effectively filters weak crossover signals, improving win rate
cons: 在震荡行情中均线交叉策略会产生频繁的虚假信号，即使有RSI过滤也难以完全避免
缺乏先进的资金管理机制，如动态仓位调整、最大回撤限制和账户权益保护
止损止盈为固定点数设计，未考虑ATR等波动率指标进行自适应调整
没有多时间周期确认机制，单一时间框架信号可靠性有限
cons_en: MA crossover strategies generate frequent false signals in ranging markets even with RSI filtering
Lacks advanced money management mechanisms such as dynamic position sizing, max drawdown limits, and account equity protection
Stop-loss and take-profit use fixed pip values without ATR-based volatility adaptation
No multi-timeframe confirmation, limiting signal reliability from a single timeframe
improvements: 增加ATR自适应止损止盈，根据市场波动率动态调整出场水平
加入多时间周期趋势确认机制，提高信号可靠性和过滤效果
实现基于风险百分比的动态仓位管理，替代固定手数交易
improvements_en: Add ATR-based adaptive stop-loss and take-profit that dynamically adjusts exit levels based on market volatility
Implement multi-timeframe trend confirmation to improve signal reliability and filtering effectiveness
Implement risk-percentage-based dynamic position sizing instead of fixed lot trading

risk_points: 固定止损止盈在高低波动市场中可能不合适，高波动时止损太小易被扫，低波动时止盈难以触及
缺乏最大持仓和最大回撤保护机制，极端行情下可能造成较大亏损
均线交叉策略本身具有滞后性，入场时趋势可能已走过大半
risk_points_en: Fixed stop-loss and take-profit may be inappropriate across varying volatility regimes - too tight in high volatility, too far in low volatility
No maximum position or max drawdown protection, potentially causing significant losses in extreme market conditions
MA crossover inherently lags, entering after a significant portion of the trend may have already passed

It enters long when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and RSI confirms momentum, and enters short on the reverse condition. The strategy is a classic trend-following approach with an RSI momentum filter to reduce false signals.
